title: The Wrong House
author: Beatrix Halloran
blurb: Lena Nakamura, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
